_comment: Desired protected-main target: direct CI required contexts plus NATIVE review-thread resolution. The Review Gate aggregate status and its trusted workflow_run bridge retired 2026-08-31 (#1008 superseded) — the two-way comment discipline (resolved threads + acknowledged bot findings) is enforced natively by required_review_thread_resolution and by the local pre-merge hook, not by a required LLM-generated status.
_preservation: Keep every other effective protection rule, enforcement mode, bypass actor, and branch condition unchanged.
_canary: The live canary must prove both direct CI checks on the exact head and the exact two-context ruleset.
